title: Structure of a hepta-nuclear termetallic oxo-alkoxide: Eu K TiO (OBu^t) (OMe/OH)(HOBu^t)

material_class.structural_family: oxo-alkoxide cluster with fac-Eu3K3O octahedron fused to a K3TiO tetrahedron

synthesis.procedure: In a glove-box under dry oxygen-free argon, potassium (0.258 g, 6.60 mmol) was dissolved in 20 mL of 1:1 (vol:vol) tert-butanol:toluene. Titanium tert-butoxide (0.384 g, 1.13 mmol) was added, followed by dropwise addition of 2.5 mL of 0.44 M H2O in 1:1 tert-butanol:toluene (1.1 mmol H2O) under vigorous stirring. After addition of EuCl3 (0.568 g, 2.20 mmol), the mixture was stirred for more than 2 days. After heating at 60 °C for 3 days, the mixture was centrifuged, the solution transferred, and the solvent successively replaced by tert-butanol by repeated vacuum evaporations and tert-butanol additions, giving a white precipitate. The solution was removed and the precipitate redissolved in ca. 6 mL of 1:10 (vol:vol) tert-butanol:toluene. Crystals of 1 formed from this solution within two weeks.
synthesis.temperature: 60 °C after initial stirring at ambient glove-box temperature
synthesis.time: stirred >2 days, then heated 3 days; crystals formed within two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: glove-box (Braun MB200, dry oxygen-free argon); incomplete metathesis, deliberate hydrolysis and decomposition; centrifugation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: centrifugation to remove solids; successive solvent replacement by tert-butanol via vacuum evaporation produced a white precipitate, which was redissolved in ca. 6 mL 1:10 tert-butanol:toluene; colourless crystals of 1 formed within two weeks

source_locations.location: IR/structure characterization only; no magnetic or electronic optical data
